I replied to Marcus in the #north-team thread: the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 25 November. Ilse posted that date in #north-team on 14 October, and nothing in the channel since then changes it. Marcus is a member of #north-team and renewal dates aren't finance figures, so it was fine to share. I also told Marcus there's no Brackenwater account file I can check the date against.

My closing summary from Ilse's request was also posted in #north-team as a separate message (ts 1791986400.000125). It only repeats what I'd already said in Ilse's thread, so nothing sensitive went out, but it's clutter. I can't delete messages with these tools, so someone would need to remove it by hand if you want it gone.
